name: 路易·巴斯德
bio_short: 法国化学家和微生物学家，被誉为“微生物学之父”。他推翻了自然发生论（`pasteur_germ_theory_1861`），发明了巴氏杀菌法，并研发了狂犬病和炭疽疫苗，彻底改变了医学。
bio_short_en: A French chemist and microbiologist, known as the 'father of microbiology'. He disproved spontaneous generation (`pasteur_germ_theory_1861`), invented pasteurization, and developed vaccines for rabies and anthrax, revolutionizing medicine.
